ship.provenance: Expedition kit 2026-10-17: one neutral hull painted in three facings (E, NE, SE); W, NW, SW mirror them (design/animation-contract.json). Never rotate the flat picture to steer.

flag.mirror: Mirror only ship art; transform flag anchor x→1−x and never mirror text or portrait
flag.emptyShip: No hero flag, owner/neutral marker only

embark.event: Commit rule command first; crossfade rider avatar to vessel

disembark.event: Commit legal coast landing first; crossfade vessel to rider

boarding.event: Hold vessels stationary during tactical scene transition

hit.event: Presentation cue only; no new persistent hull HP implied

sinking.event: After confirmed defeat; fade old hull to wreck then remove; do not delay logical defeat

ship.reducedMotion: Disable bob, roll, wake and shaking; preserve state changes and readable ownership

wagon.provenance: Expedition kit 2026-10-17: the shared caravan wagon painted in three facings (E, NE, SE); W, NW, SW mirror them. A map token with a path tween and a restrained cart bob; no horse gait strip.

motion.method: Directional painted token with gentle cart bob and position tween; no anatomical horse gait frames

wagon.reducedMotion: Disable bob, roll, wake and shaking; preserve state changes and readable ownership
